blocks.text:
This programme is for travellers who want to explore Chile and Argentina on an extensive journey, rather than limiting their trip to one or two cities. It takes in the coast, steppe, ice fields, national parks, subtropical forest and major capitals. Each flight brings a striking change of scenery.

## Why the route offers so much variety

Santiago and the Pacific coast introduce Chile through its urban history, the port city of Valparaíso and the seaside resort of Viña del Mar. Patagonia then takes centre stage: Torres del Paine, the Milodón Cave, the ice fields of Los Glaciares and Perito Moreno.

Bariloche reveals a greener Patagonia of lakes and forests. After that, Iguazu feels almost like a different continent: humid forest, 275 waterfalls, the Macuco boat trip and a flight over the cascades. Buenos Aires completes the route with a city tour followed by an evening tango show and dinner.

This sequence takes you from the Andes and the Pacific through the cold south and its glaciers to the subtropics, before ending in the Argentine capital.
